URGENCY.label: Urgent
URGENCY.why: The message pushes you to act fast so you have no time to think or check.

REWARD_BAIT.label: Reward bait
REWARD_BAIT.why: A promised prize or handout is used to grab your attention and your data.

FALSE_AUTHORITY.label: Claims authority
FALSE_AUTHORITY.why: The message claims to come from an official body without any proof you can check.

FEAR.label: Scare tactic
FEAR.why: Threats such as a blocked account are used to make you panic and comply.

SECRECY.label: Asks for secrecy
SECRECY.why: Being told to keep it secret stops you from asking anyone else.

OUTRAGE_BAIT.label: Outrage bait
OUTRAGE_BAIT.why: The message is written to make you angry so you share it too.

IMPERSONATION.label: Impersonation
IMPERSONATION.why: The message imitates another person or organisation to look trustworthy.

FAKE_SOCIAL_PROOF.label: Fake social proof
FAKE_SOCIAL_PROOF.why: Claims that many people already joined are used to make you feel safe to follow.
